idea: Dijkstra with a guide. Each node gets a score f = g + h: g is the distance found so far, h is the straight-line distance to the end. Always settle the node with the smallest f, so the search leans toward the goal and often looks at fewer nodes.
time: O((V + E) log V) worst case, usually far fewer nodes are settled than with Dijkstra
useWhen: Nodes have positions (a map) and you need the shortest route to one end node
The straight line is never longer than any real edge, so the guide never overestimates
avoidWhen: Some edge is shorter than the straight line between its nodes: the guide can overestimate and the route can be wrong (this app scales the guide down and warns)
You need the distance to every node, not one end node (use Dijkstra)
